themes_detail.label: Obstruction Crisis on Streets
themes_detail.summary: Obstruction complaints in CD313 spiked to 5 THIS WEEK, a 1900% increase vs. the 8-week baseline of 0.2 complaints/week (z-score: 10.97), suggesting a sudden street-blocking hazard affecting pedestrian and vehicle access.
evidence: 5 obstruction complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.2/week 8-week average (1900% spike, z-score 10.97)
Highest statistical anomaly in current dataset by z-score
No prior signal in Reddit, news, or community board — suggests sudden onset
reporting_angles: Street survey: what physical obstructions appeared this week (construction debris, illegally parked containers, downed signs, etc.)?
Interview DOE and NYPD to identify pattern—is this localized to one block or district-wide?

themes_detail.label: Encampment Surge in Coney Island
themes_detail.summary: Encampment complaints surged to 11 THIS WEEK, a 633% spike vs. the 8-week baseline of 1.5/week (z-score: 5.08), signaling a rapid increase in homeless encampments or squatter occupation on public land.
evidence: 11 encampment complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.5/week 8-week average (633% increase, z-score 5.08)
Second-most severe statistical anomaly in dataset
No corresponding Reddit, news, or community board discussion—potential data-journalism opportunity
reporting_angles: Street-level reporting: Map encampment locations (parks, beachfront, commercial blocks) and interview residents/business owners on safety and sanitation impacts.
Policy angle: Why the sudden surge? Eviction moratoria ending, weather shift, or resource reallocation by homeless services?

themes_detail.label: Street Sweeping Neglect Spike
themes_detail.summary: Street sweeping complaints jumped to 7 THIS WEEK, a 700% increase vs. the 8-week baseline of 0.9/week (z-score: 5.82), indicating rapid deterioration in sanitation service or accumulation of debris.
evidence: 7 street sweeping complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.9/week 8-week average (700% spike, z-score 5.82)
Converges with 'Dirty Condition' complaints (177 over 90 days) as sustained baseline issue
Possible overlap with obstruction surge—debris may be blocking streets
reporting_angles: DSNY scheduling audit: Did street sweeping routes change or staffing drop this week in CD313?
Block-by-block visual survey: Which neighborhoods are seeing the most litter accumulation?

themes_detail.label: Air Quality Alert in Beachfront District
themes_detail.summary: Air quality complaints rose to 3 LAST WEEK, a 2300% spike vs. the 8-week baseline of 0.1/week (z-score: 8.69), suggesting smoke, odor, or pollution episode affecting the beachfront community.
evidence: 3 air quality complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.1/week 8-week average (2300% increase, z-score 8.69)
High z-score but timing is 1 week old—less urgent than obstruction/encampment/sweeping spikes THIS WEEK
No corroborating news or social media; possible industrial incident, beach fire, or weather-driven pollution
reporting_angles: EPA/DEP air monitor data: Was there a recorded pollution or odor event in CD313 during that week?
Source investigation: Nearby industrial facilities, construction sites, or beach activities (grilling, etc.)?

themes_detail.label: Facility Maintenance Backlog Emerging
themes_detail.summary: Maintenance/facility complaints reached 10 THIS WEEK, a 264% increase vs. the 8-week baseline of 2.8/week (z-score: 4.9), indicating deferred repairs across parks, playgrounds, or public buildings.
evidence: 10 maintenance complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.8/week 8-week average (264% spike, z-score 4.9)
Active ULURP applications for Seaside Park & Community Arts Center suggest ongoing facility planning
May relate to Mermaid Parade funding crisis (Gothamist, 3/31/2026) indicating broader Coney Island infrastructure strain
reporting_angles: Parks/DCLA facility audit: Which public buildings or parks are experiencing the most complaints this week?
Mermaid Parade angle: Is the reported 'urgent financial crisis' extending to broader park maintenance budgets?
